context_requirements: Neuronal or neuroblastoma lineage for robust BACE1-dependent APP processing
Expression of BACE1 and its substrate APP
Presence of the amyloidogenic APP processing pathway
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in APP, APOE, or other landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Consistent upregulation of unfolded protein response or oxidative stress genes across multiple lines
A shared transcriptional signature across the nine lines that is absent in vehicle controls
